name: Edem Robin
title: Network Engineer | Python & Android Developer

professional.introduction: Hi, I’m Edem Robin — a Network Engineer, Python & Android Developer, and technology enthusiast passionate about building, automating, and simplifying systems. I work at the intersection of networking and software, transforming complex technical challenges into practical, reliable solutions that connect technology with real-world needs.
focus: Infrastructure monitoring with Zabbix and Grafana
philosophy: Health, wisdom, and continuous growth come first.
professional.personality: I enjoy blending creativity with technical precision, designing systems that are both powerful and simple to use, while occasionally weaving humor into technology — yes, even UDP jokes.
professional.future_vision: I am working toward building innovative solutions that improve connectivity, automation, and digital payments, creating technology that is efficient, scalable, and accessible.
professional.closing: This portfolio is my small corner of the internet where I share my work, projects, experiments, and growth along the journey. Welcome!

funny.text: Hey again 👋! I’m Edem — a firm believer that beautiful is better than ugly and simple is better than complex. Passionate about sharing knowledge, I thrive on hard work, perseverance, and self-discipline. I may not be your typical tech guy, but I can tell you a joke about UDP… though you probably won’t get it. I can also tell you a joke about TCP — and I guarantee you will get it, though it might take a few retries! Don’t worry, I won’t force-close our interaction… though an exception might occasionally occur 😉. At the end of the day, I’m just a simple computer user with a special talent for clicking icons.
